decisions.statement: A rename names every file still spelling the old name and refuses none of them.
The old name is matched whole, so a longer name holding it is passed over.
The body weighed is the body the change leaves rather than the body on disk.
A file a generator writes is left out, a refresh writing that file again.
A name in more files than the ceiling is counted rather than named.
The tree is searched once for the old name, whatever kind of file holds it.
Nothing here says which line an old name is written on.
Nothing here spells an old name anew.

definition: the files an old name is still written in once a change has repointed what it reaches
